about: The Workbench icons of the BlockOut drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's BlockOut/block_icon.ico (its 48x48 picture). BlockOut-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BlockOut.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BlockOut.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for data.
